businessModel: Free; optional Patron subscription ($4/month or $30/year) unlocks workspaces
updateCadence: Multiple releases per week in October 2026
summary: Blanc is a brand-new Electron-based browser that replaces the tab strip and toolbar with a small floating Island showing navigation, tab dots, domain and blocked-request count. It blocks ads with EasyList/EasyPrivacy and deliberately has no extension runtime.
bestFor: People who want an ultra-minimal UI
Mac, Windows and Linux users wanting built-in blocking
Early adopters comfortable with a new project
notFor: Anyone who needs a mature, long-lived browser

pros.title: Distinct minimal UI
pros.detail: The Island combines navigation, address bar, command palette and quick switcher.

pros.title: Network-level blocking
pros.detail: Bundled EasyList/EasyPrivacy snapshots via Ghostery adblocker, with a live blocked count.

pros.title: MIT source
pros.detail: Repo is MIT-licensed with transparent release notes.

pros.title: Cross-platform
pros.detail: macOS, Windows installer and Linux AppImage.

cons.title: Very new, single maintainer
cons.detail: Launched in 2026; long-term support is unproven.

cons.title: No extensions
cons.detail: The maker shipped an extension runtime, then removed it after crashes and sandboxing/licensing issues.

cons.title: Nag for Patron plan
cons.detail: OMG! Ubuntu reports a new-tab button for the paid plan that cannot be hidden.

cons.title: Unclear licensing signals
cons.detail: AlternativeTo calls it source-available while the repo lists MIT.

faq.a: The GitHub repo is MIT-licensed; AlternativeTo describes it differently, and trademarks are reserved.
